eligibility_text: Traditional artisans and craftspeople aged 18+, self-employed in the unorganised sector, actively working in one of 18 designated family trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, cobbler, tailor, goldsmith, etc.). Government employees and their families are not eligible; only one member per family may register.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card; skill training with a Rs 500/day stipend; a Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive; collateral-free loans up to Rs 1 lakh (first tranche) then Rs 2 lakh (second tranche) at 5% concessional interest.
